title: UserProfileCyberProgram
description: A user profile's standing in the Cyber Verification Program, which relaxes cyber safeguards for requests that name the profile.

status.description: `active` when at least one tier is `active`, or when the profile has the program's access to earlier models. That access is not a tier: a profile that has it alone reads `active` with every tier `inactive`, or with `tiers` `{}` on a response that does not report tiers. When nothing is `active`, `pending` means that an application or enrollment is under review, or that what Anthropic approved does not yet apply to this profile, and `rejected` means that the application or enrollment was declined.

tiers.description: The program's tiers, keyed by tier: `a` (Specialized Access), `b` (Red Team Access) and `c` (Defense Access). A response reports either every tier or none. When it reports them, as retrieving the profile normally does, every tier has a key, whether or not it applies to the profile. When it does not, as in the list of user profiles, `tiers` is `{}`, which does not mean that the tiers are inactive. No tier implies another, so read the tier you need. Anthropic may add tiers; ignore a key you do not recognize.

requirements.description: What a request that names the profile must allow to get the relaxed safeguards of every `active` tier. `null` when no tier is `active`, and wherever `tiers` is `{}`.
